name: audit-log-lab
description: Lab bài 02/04: Audit Log (trigger + JSONB) và Soft Delete cho hợp đồng bảo hiểm trên PostgreSQL 16

scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d insurance -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v contracts=${CONTRACTS:-40000} -f /lab/db/seed-contracts.sql
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d insurance -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /lab/db/migrate.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d insurance
